name: Theo
source:
They/Them

Your oldest friend, but also most complicated. Your relationship with them has been strained since you left town almost a year ago. Now, you're back, and there's a chance things can finally return to normal. Or perhaps, change forever...

"... at this new house, we're so close to each other… Maybe we can see each other… I've missed you."

[From [url=https://shewassaying.itch.io/titanarum]itch.io[/url]]
